title: Week 2 Assessment: Booking API v2
rules: Mentor present. AI use follows the day's rule (Sunday project: afternoon rules; explain-back still applies).
Tick a task only when you can demonstrate it live and explain the code behind it.
Every fix or finding is written up as symptom → cause → fix → how verified.

parts.title: Auth works securely
tasks: Passwords hashed (argon2/bcrypt), never logged; emails unique case-insensitively
Same 401 message for unknown user and wrong password; tokens expire; secrets in .env
Email/password and Google login both work; state checked; linking requires email_verified + password confirmation

parts.title: Roles + ownership correct
tasks: Owner, staff, customer permissions match the written matrix
Customer cannot read or cancel another customer's booking (tested)
Every route has an explicit permission rule: 401 without login, 403 for wrong role

parts.title: Security hardening
tasks: Helmet, CORS allowlist (frontend origin only), rate limit on login/signup
Origin check: POST with Origin https://evil.example returns 403
npm audit + Semgrep findings fixed or documented; SQLi, mass assignment and IDOR attacks written up

parts.title: Tests + CI
tasks: Integration tests for signup, login, logout, roles and ownership against a real Postgres
GitHub Actions runs lint + tests with the pgvector service container; coverage 80%+ on auth and booking logic
Branch protection blocks a PR with a failing test

parts.title: README + security notes
tasks: Scope updated first from the client message
Security notes: what was tested, how, and results
